tool.name: WGCNA: Weighted Gene Co-expression Network Analysis
tool.description: Construct gene co-expression networks and identify modules correlated with traits
tool.command:
## Create working directory for cytoscape outputs (dynamic files) mkdir -p cytoscape_output &&
Rscript '$__tool_directory__/wgcna.R' --vst_matrix '$vst_matrix' --sample_info '$sample_info'
## Optional DEG files #if $deg_section.use_degs == "yes": --up_degs '$deg_section.up_degs' --down_degs '$deg_section.down_degs' #else: --up_degs 'None' --down_degs 'None' #end if
## Column names --sample_col '$col_names.sample_col' --treatment_col '$col_names.treatment_col' #if $col_names.case_label: --case_label '$col_names.case_label' #end if
## Filtering --presence_pct '$filtering.presence_pct' --var_percentile '$filtering.var_percentile'
## Network --soft_power '$network.soft_power' --network_type '$network.network_type' --min_module_size '$network.min_module_size' --merge_cut_height '$network.merge_cut_height' --max_block_size '$network.max_block_size' --n_threads '$network.n_threads'
## Thresholds --kme_threshold '$thresholds.kme_threshold' --cor_threshold '$thresholds.cor_threshold' --tom_percentile '$thresholds.tom_percentile'
## Output paths --out_plot_clustering '$out_plot_clustering' --out_plot_soft '$out_plot_soft' --out_plot_dendro '$out_plot_dendro' --out_plot_heatmap_all '$out_plot_heatmap_all' --out_plot_mm_gs '$out_plot_mm_gs' --out_plot_hubs '$out_plot_hubs' --out_plot_heatmap_sel '$out_plot_heatmap_sel' --out_plot_deg_bar '$out_plot_deg_bar' --out_table_modules '$out_table_modules' --out_table_gs_mm '$out_table_gs_mm' --out_table_hubs '$out_table_hubs' --out_table_sel_modules '$out_table_sel_modules' --out_table_deg_summary '$out_table_deg_summary' --out_cytoscape_dir cytoscape_output --out_rdata '$out_rdata'
2>&1 | tee '$out_log'

param.name: vst_matrix
param.label: VST-normalized expression matrix
param.help: Tab-separated file: first column = gene IDs (row names), remaining columns = samples. Header must contain sample IDs.

param.name: sample_info
param.label: Sample metadata file
param.help: Tab-separated file with at minimum two columns: SampleID and Treatment (column names are configurable below).

param.name: sample_col
param.label: Sample ID column name
param.help: Column in metadata containing sample identifiers matching expression matrix headers.

param.name: treatment_col
param.label: Treatment/group column name
param.help: Column in metadata containing group labels (e.g. Induced, Control).

param.name: case_label
param.label: Case group label (optional)
param.help: Label of the 'case' group for trait encoding (e.g. 'Induced'). Auto-detected if left blank.

param.name: up_degs
param.label: Up-regulated gene list
param.help: File containing up-regulated gene IDs. Supported formats: TXT, TSV/TABULAR, CSV. First column must contain gene IDs. No header required.

param.name: down_degs
param.label: Down-regulated gene list
param.help: File containing down-regulated gene IDs. Supported formats: TXT, TSV/TABULAR, CSV. First column must contain gene IDs. No header required.

data.name: out_table_gs_mm
data.label: ${tool.name}: Gene significance and module membership (top module)

tool.help:
.. class:: infomark
**What it does**
This tool performs **Weighted Gene Co-expression Network Analysis (WGCNA)** on VST-normalized RNA-seq expression data. It constructs a gene co-expression network, identifies modules of co-regulated genes, correlates modules with experimental traits, and exports hub genes and Cytoscape-ready network files.
-----
**Pipeline overview**
1. **Data loading** — VST expression matrix + sample metadata 2. **Gene filtering** — presence filter (non-zero in ≥ X% of samples) + variance filter 3. **Trait matrix** — binary encoding of the treatment variable 4. **Sample clustering** — hierarchical clustering to check for outliers 5. **Soft-threshold selection** — scale-free topology fit to choose β 6. **Network construction** — ``blockwiseModules`` with signed/unsigned adjacency 7. **Module-trait correlation** — Pearson r between module eigengenes and trait 8. **Gene significance & module membership** — GS and kME for the top module 9. **Hub genes** — top 10% most connected genes in the top module 10. **kME filtering** — keep only core module members (|kME| > threshold) 11. **Cytoscape export** — edge + node tables for all high-correlation modules 12. **DEG overlap** *(optional)* — overlap between network genes and DEG lists
-----
**Input files**
+-----------------------------+--------------------------------------------------+ | **VST matrix** | TSV, genes × samples. First column = gene IDs. | | | Header must contain sample IDs. | +-----------------------------+--------------------------------------------------+ | **Sample metadata** | TSV with at least two columns: | | | ``SampleID`` and ``Treatment`` (configurable). | +-----------------------------+--------------------------------------------------+ | **Up/down DEG lists** | *(Optional)* TSV, first column = gene IDs. | | | No header required. | +-----------------------------+--------------------------------------------------+
**Example metadata file** ::
SampleID Treatment Sample_A_1 Induced Sample_A_2 Induced Sample_A_3 Induced Sample_B_1 Control Sample_B_2 Control Sample_B_3 Control
-----
**Key parameters**
- **Soft-thresholding power (β):** Set to 0 for automatic detection (recommended). Inspect the soft-threshold plot if auto-detection fails. - **Network type:** ``signed`` preserves the direction of co-expression; ``unsigned`` treats up- and down-regulation equivalently. - **Minimum module size:** Smaller values yield more, smaller modules. - **kME threshold:** Genes with |kME| > threshold are considered core module members. - **Correlation threshold:** Modules with |r| ≥ threshold are selected for Cytoscape export.
-----
**Outputs**
+------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+ | Sample clustering plot | Outlier detection | +------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+ | Soft-threshold plot | Power selection guidance | +------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+ | Gene dendrogram | Module color assignments | +------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+ | Full module-trait heatmap | All modules × all traits | +------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+ | MM vs GS scatter plot | Top module relevance validation | +------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+ | Hub gene plot | Connectivity vs kME | +------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+ | Selected modules heatmap | High-correlation modules | +------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+ | DEG barplot *(optional)* | DEG distribution per module | +------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+ | Module gene assignments (TSV) | All genes with module colors | +------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+ | GS/MM table (TSV) | Top module detailed statistics | +------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+ | Hub genes table (TSV) | Hub gene list with connectivity | +------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+ | Selected modules summary (TSV) | Correlation table for export mods | +------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+ | DEG network summary (TSV) *(optional)* | DEG counts per network module | +------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+ | Cytoscape networks (collection) | Edge + node files per module | +------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+ | RData workspace | All objects for downstream use | +------------------------------------------+------------------------------------+
-----
**Importing Cytoscape files**
The ``edges_*_kMEfilt.txt`` and ``nodes_*_kMEfilt.txt`` files can be imported directly into `Cytoscape <https://cytoscape.org/>`_ using **File → Import → Network from File** (edges) and then **File → Import → Table from File** (nodes).
-----
**References**
- Langfelder P, Horvath S. WGCNA: an R package for weighted gene co-expression network analysis. *BMC Bioinformatics* 2008, 9:559. https://doi.org/10.1186/1471-2105-9-559 - Zhang B, Horvath S. A general framework for weighted gene co-expression network analysis. *Statistical Applications in Genetics and Molecular Biology* 2005. https://doi.org/10.2202/1544-6115.1128
